prompt: The September Declaration has a rough equivalent in the Netherlands that takes place on the same day every year. In what century was the current name of this day (as of August 2024) chosen?
answer: The current name **“Prinsjesdag” (Prince’s Day)** was chosen in the **19th century**. It was originally the celebration of Prince William V’s birthday on 8 March; the name was later applied to the annual opening of Parliament. It was officially associated with that event by the 1930s.
